preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 10^6.
The maximum weight of an edge m must be between 1 and 10^6.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b
preconditions.description: The favorite vertices a and b must be distinct and within the range of vertices.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of beautiful trees modulo 10^9 + 7.
